trust_decision.summary: Whether a request to the local Next.js dashboard's /api surface comes from the app's own origin on a loopback Host; at the pinned commit nothing decides it (no middleware/proxy, no per-route origin or host check), and the fix adds one proxy over /api/:path* backed by checkRequest().

landing_point.why: The summary says 'local dashboard API ... command execution'; /api/run is the route that spawns the agent CLI from a POSTed body, so a reader goes there first (or to a missing middleware/proxy file under web/src).

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP request matching /api/:path* (Next 16 proxy, web/src/proxy.ts, new file)
checkRequest() called only by proxy.ts (web/src/lib/origin-guard.mjs, new file)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Non-/api page routes (e.g. web/src/app/pipeline/[id]/page.tsx) only read and render data and never spawn or write, so a solver can argue the advisory's command-execution property does not cover them; the published fix itself scopes the guard to /api only (fix.diff:377).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The app's own no-Origin GETs into /api must keep working: subresource loads and a plain link to /api/cv-pdf opened as a navigation; also curl with no Origin and opt-in LAN hosts. A fix that demands an Origin header, a JSON content-type or a custom header on every /api request breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: Sec-Fetch-Site present: same-origin/none allowed, same-site/cross-site blocked (fix.diff:327-330)
Origin present but host differs from Host -> blocked (fix.diff:342-344)
Host forms: host:port, bracketed IPv6, bare IPv6, 127.0.0.0/8, localhost; missing Host blocked (fix.diff:268-286, fix.diff:314-321)
Opt-in host list split on comma/whitespace with ports stripped (fix.diff:289-297)

Body shapes reaching sinks: JSON parsed regardless of content-type (web/src/app/api/run/route.ts:26) and multipart/form-data (web/src/app/api/cv/ingest/route.ts:73-74); the fix is header-based, so both are covered with no content-type check

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Server-rendered page routes outside /api render the user's reports, tracker and CV data on any Host, so the fix's loopback Host layer (F2) does not cover LAN or DNS-rebinding reads of them.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Read-only (no spawn or write in any page.tsx); the advisory is about command execution, and the published fix deliberately matches only /api/:path* (fix.diff:377).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (web/), different subtree (src/app/* pages vs src/app/api/*)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A server action ('use server') or a page-level form handler that writes portals/tracker data outside the /api matcher.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Next app-router projects commonly add server actions for forms; no 'use server' exists today, so a maintainer adding one would not get the /api proxy for free.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second, non-Next local listener (e.g. a node:http helper for the browser-extract or apply flows) that reaches the same spawnHeadlessCli sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The repo already runs many standalone .mjs scripts next to web/; a quick local HTTP bridge would naturally sit outside web/src/proxy.ts.

O9_family: CSRF / cross-origin + DNS-rebinding/LAN exposure of a local dev-server API (CWE-352, CWE-1385)

O10_build.project_tests: web/tests/lib/*.test.mjs (pure-module unit tests); none cover origin/host checks at the pinned commit; the fix adds web/tests/lib/origin-guard.test.mjs (fix.diff:383-566)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an Origin check (or a JSON content-type check) inside /api/run only, leaving the other ~30 spawning/writing /api routes and the LAN Host exposure open.

out_of_scope_notes: web/src/app/api/logo/route.ts:67 GET fetches remote logos by company name; possible SSRF surface, not this advisory.
web/src/app/api/run/route.ts:112-117 notes non-Claude CLIs run without tool restrictions (#2507); prompt-injection surface, not this advisory.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check run).
O1 counts the 33 route.ts files under web/src/app/api; each is reachable without a guard at the pinned commit, but not every handler was read to confirm a spawn/write sink.
Whether Next 16 proxy matcher '/api/:path*' is bypassable by path-case or encoding variants was not checked (framework behaviour, not project code).
single_site is flagged because the published fix is one choke-point proxy; the O8 page-route gap is read-only and arguably outside the advisory's property, so the flag may be contested.
present_in_latest is unknown for all O8 routes (latest release: none).
